summary: Missoula County, MT platform tower and cabin dated to the 1930s on Lolo NF; firelookout.com says ruins, the Association lists it gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: firelookout.com describes ruins ('1930s: 20' platform tower, cabin. Ruins.'); the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as Gone; no source dates the ruins description

events.note: firelookout.com dates the platform tower and cabin only to the 1930s; the year 1930 is a placeholder for that decade, not a source date

evidence.supports: firelookout.com describes ruins; only description of remains
listed under Missoula County, Lolo National Forest
the Missoula West region list includes Frenchtown

sources.title: Missoula West Region Montana Forest Fire Lookout Tower Sites

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com describes the site as ruins; the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists the tower as Gone. The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Only firelookout.com dates the lookout (1930s) and describes its remains (ruins). Forest Lookouts gives the legal location and agency. Two searches found no history of this lookout. The 1930 event year is only the start of the decade, not a source date. Missoula ranger district or Lolo NF heritage files may hold site records.
